مُجَمِّرٌ (S, Z) and ↓ مُجْمِرٌ (TA) One who collects together his hair, and ties it in knots, or makes it knotted and crisp, at the back of his neck, not letting it hang down loosely: (S:) or who plaits the hair of his head. (TA.) He who does so (while he is a مُحْرِم, TA) is commanded to shave his head. (S and TA from a trad.) ＝
-A2- Also, both the former and ↓ جَامِرٌ , which is a possessive epithet, without a verb, One whose business is to fumigate garments [&c.] with perfume. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
